name: guardclaw
description: GuardClaw guard for Claude Code: denies destructive shell commands, pipe-to-shell installs, credential egress and writes to credential paths, and refuses other mods that could approve tool calls. Deny-only and fail-closed.

allowMods.title: Mods allowed to hook tool approval
allowMods.description: Names or name@marketplace ids of mods that may load even though they hook tool.call, tool.check, session.append, classic.PreToolUse or classic.PermissionRequest. Prefer name@marketplace: a name alone is whatever the mod's own plugin.json says.

extraDenyPatterns.title: Extra deny patterns
extraDenyPatterns.description: JavaScript regular expressions matched (case-insensitive) against every Bash command. A pattern that does not compile denies every Bash call until it is fixed, so a typo never opens the guard.
